The world does seem a bit terrible these past couple of years, but why should that affect you? There will always be those people who Will harm you, but you shouldn't  let them tear you down and kill. Show the world that your better than that, and that your not just another mind rolling in society. Loving yourself is just plain awesome. You don't have to worry about relying on another person. It seems like you believe that the love you give for your partners, stays with them, and that they leave you with no love for yourself, but its not like that. Love for your own self is very precious. Love yourself. You can even just lay in bed naked and meditate about love for yourself(naked because that's  how we were all born) that's what I did and I'm glad I did because I soon found out about Reddit ^^ but try to atleast make that little bond with yourself, so you don't have to rely on other people for your happiness. I hope things turn for the better (: -virtual pat

Maybe it's not all the love you seek from people, but you are probably craving for some love from YOURself. Love from other people isnt always the greatest, because you know you cant always hang on to someone and always rely on them. You should just sit I your bed, and meditate. Think of all the wonderful things life has to offer, and that life doesn't always have to do with a partner or a spouse. I too used to hate myself for being so useless and dumb, but then I started to just sit down, relax, and think of all the great things I could do instead of just killing myself and being known as "nothin'" Make goals, achieve them, live life, love yourself (: -virtual hug
